name: Fuyutsuki Tooya
source:
"[i]Well, if you come along, Taiga... then sure, that's fine. If it's not just me alone... if we go together, then maybe we could go look around tonight too.[/i]"

A [b]special kitten[/b] who can transform into a human.

She lives with her older sister at a mysterious general store
tucked away in a corner of town.
She's not great at studying, and she’s especially bad at math.

She is shy and easily lonely.
But she always looks forward to Taiga coming over to play.
Despite her introverted personality,
she is just a little bit cheeky toward Taiga.
There's also a slightly dangerous side to her...
show her some snacks and she'll follow you just about anywhere.

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 126cm
[i]Measurements[/i]: B60 / W48 / H67
[i]Favorite food[/i]: Her big sister's home cooking. Also pudding.
[i]Blood type[/i]: O
[i]Birthday[/i]: June 6th

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]
